items.title: U.S. strikes on Iran fail to stir bitcoin, on track for best month since November 2024
items.article_summary: Bitcoin held steady despite a broader risk-off move after the first U.S. strikes against Iran for weeks sent oil higher and stocks lower. The cryptocurrency has gained 24% this month.
